summary: 10.x architecture boundary definition — seven platform-neutral contract docs + shared schema/interface skeleton (pure)
deliverables: Update-Plan/10-x/ARCHITECTURE.md: phase coverage, universal envelope, universal principles (fail isolated/explicit, provenance, local-first, offline-is-a-state, no forced uniformity)
Update-Plan/10-x/NODE-CONTRACT.md: node identity + capability advertisement + node state + NodeCapabilityReport output (10B/10C)
Update-Plan/10-x/FLEET-CONTRACT.md: fleet control plane responsibilities + task lease/ownership + dynamic scheduler + failure-isolation scenarios 1-7 (10D/10E/10F/10P)
Update-Plan/10-x/KNOWLEDGE-CONTRACT.md: one user knowledge space, knowledge record, pipeline, dedup/conflict, local fallback + deferred sync (10G/10H/10I/10J)
Update-Plan/10-x/ARTIFACT-CONTRACT.md: artifact taxonomy + record fields + append rules + degraded behavior (10K)
Update-Plan/10-x/NETWORK-CONTRACT.md: per-node network state + provider reachability matrix + platform adapter layer (10L/10M/10Q)
Update-Plan/10-x/SESSION-CONTRACT.md: session kinds TEMPORARY/REUSABLE/PERSISTENT/AUTO_DELETE + login health scanner output (10N/10O)
src/shared/tenx/contracts.ts: TENX_CONTRACT_VERSION 10.0.0, TenxContractId coverage, schema markers, TenxEnvelope wire envelope, isTenxEnvelope validator, roundTrip helper

src/shared/tenx/{node,network,fleet,scheduler,knowledge,artifact,session,inspection}.ts: pure schema/interface skeletons per contract with minimal deterministic helpers (behavior lands in owning phases)
tests: tests/unit/tenx-phase-10a.test.ts (4 tests): version+coverage marker check; deterministic envelope validation (rejects bad sentAt / unknown schema / null); JSON round-trip of node/fleet/knowledge/artifact/provider sample records; platform-neutrality scan asserting src/shared/tenx has no node:/electron/OS imports

gates.full_suite: baseline 167/167 PASS before this phase (re-run at phase end)

notes: Docs are ASCII-safe English to avoid the GBK mojibake seen in older plan docs. Schema skeleton is deliberately lean; each later phase (10B-10R) adds durable registries/state machines on top of these vocabulary types, keeping this branch compilable and testable at every step.
